```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 07_sampling_sampling_distribution
title: >
  Sampling Distribution Probabilities
questions:
  - id: height_mean_63
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      For the population 60, 62, 64, 66, all ordered samples of size 2 are drawn
      with replacement. What proportion of sample means equal 63? Enter a decimal.
    answer: 0.25
    tolerance: 0.001
    explanation: >
      Each of the 16 ordered samples is equally likely. Four have a mean of 63: 60/66, 62/64, 64/62, and
      66/60. So the probability is $4/16 = .25$. We count samples, not
      distinct mean values: the seven possible means are not equally likely.
```
